text:
priya: Heads-up: we need to pick an approach for late enrichment priority vs pre-enrich for trace cost attribution. TL;DR: customers want per-request cost accuracy w/out blowing latency SLOs.

sam: Quick context: late-enrich keeps ingest thin but can misattribute on sampling. Pre-enrich increases edge latency and compute cost.

liam: What are the SLA bounds here? Is this just about hostname/billing tags or full billing-key resolution with tenant mapping?

priya: Primary is for production inference traces: p95/p99 latency targets are 120ms/300ms at edge, billing accuracy target is <5% drift per customer cohort.

anna: My gut: hybrid approach. Synchronous pre-enrich for high-priority routes (payments, dedicated customers), async late-enrich for bulk traffic.

maria: +1. Need to define batching window for late-enrich. 200-500ms looks like a good starting point to keep throughput high without massive lag.

sam: Tradeoffs: larger batch window reduces per-event CPU but increases attribution lag and retry surface. Plus duplicates if we reingest.

priya: Proposal: add an `attr_priority` header with values {high, normal}. Route `high` to pre-enrich path (blocking) and `normal` to late-enrich with a 250ms micro-batch.

liam: How does sampling interact? If we sample at edge then enrich late we might lose keys for non-sampled traces. Do we need a secondary lookup service or sticky sampling?

anna: We can emit a tiny provenance header (stable request_id) from edge so late-enrich can rehydrate via a lookup. But that lookup cost could be nontrivial at scale.

maria: Suggestion: maintain an LRU cache for recent request_id -> billingKey with small TTL (30s). Hot paths will hit cache, reducing lookups.

sam: I can run a quick cost/latency sim: model cache hit rates @ 30s TTL, batch sizes, and lookup QPS. Will sketch numbers.

priya: Action items: Sam -> run cost + latency sim (ETA EOD Thu). Liam -> draft header spec + fallback lookup API. Anna -> prototype `attr_priority` routing in obs-gateway. Maria -> size cache + TTL + eviction policy. I'll coordinate rollout plan and gating.

infra-bot: created INFRA ticket INFRA-7421 for attr_priority routing and late-enrich prototyping. Link: https://tasks/redwood/INFRA-7421

priya: Also: surface attribution lag in Console per-route and emit alert when enrichment_lag > 1s. We need visibility during rollout.

sam: :thumbsup: Will add metrics: `enrichment_lag_seconds` histogram, `enrichment_retry_count`, and per-tenant `enrichment_missed_keys`.

liam: For the header spec, example payload:
```json
{"attr_priority":"high","request_id":"r-abc123","provenance":"edge-v1","tenant_id":"t-55"}
```
Use tenant_id to avoid cross-tenant stale lookups.

anna: One more wrinkle: multi-tenant billing keys — late-enrich must never expose or lookup cross-tenant keys. Enforce tenant scoping at lookup layer.

maria: And PII guardrails: billingKey stored hashed, access audited, TTLs short. Add a compliance checklist for Private deployments.

priya: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after Sam's sim. If you hit blockers while prototyping, @me and I'll unblock.
